name: random_quote
description: Get a random anime quote. Returns quote text, character name, and anime series title.

name: search_by_anime
description: Search for quotes from a specific anime series by title (e.g., "Attack on Titan"). Returns matching quotes with character and series info.

anime.description: Name of the anime series (e.g., "Naruto", "Attack on Titan")

name: search_by_character
description: Search for quotes by anime character name (e.g., "Naruto Uzumaki"). Returns matching quotes with character, series, and quote text.

character.description: Name of the anime character (e.g., "Naruto Uzumaki", "Levi Ackerman")
